TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd offers the Energy Department, Government of Punjab a delivery profile aligned to multi-site, mission-critical public infrastructure: we are SECP-incorporated (Pvt) Ltd, established in 2012, with active FBR ATL status and Punjab & Sindh sales tax registrations [CO-PROFILE]. Our ISO 9001 quality management certification directly supports your mandatory requirement for controlled design, procurement, installation, testing and commissioning processes across twelve hospitals [CO-PROFILE].

For the 5 MW aggregate grid-tied solar PV scope, we bring recent solar delivery experience at material contract values, including Solar Energy deployments completed in 2024 (PKR 171M) and 2024 (PKR 31M), and earlier federal-government solar work completed in 2020 (PKR 34M) [CAP-032][CAP-008][CAP-020]. This meets the RFP expectation for at least two successfully completed renewable/solar projects and demonstrates our ability to execute within comparable budget bands [CAP-032][CAP-008].

Differentiators that matter for public hospitals:
- Government delivery maturity: completed provincial and federal government projects, including provincial solar and federal hospital/IT deployments, reflecting familiarity with public-sector governance and operational constraints [CAP-008][CAP-020][CAP-042][CAP-018].
- Program management depth: we maintain PMP-certified project managers (6) and PE-registered engineers (4) to run parallel workfronts and disciplined commissioning handover [CO-PROFILE].
- Monitoring and support readiness: our delivery history includes large network design engagements and an in-country support desk with 24–48h response SLAs and quarterly preventive maintenance on O&M contracts—strong foundations for your SCADA-based centralized monitoring and 3-year O&M expectations [CAP-045][CAP-009][CO-PROFILE].

Our library does not yet evidence DISCO net-metering approvals by name; we will address this by assigning a dedicated regulatory liaison and, where required, partnering with an experienced net-metering consultant while retaining single-point accountability to the Department [CO-PROFILE].
